notes: The real fix this time, actually reproduced and verified before shipping: opening the profile of a brand-new character (one with no greeting written yet) threw a ReferenceError and aborted before the profile screen ever appeared — a `voicesOf` helper was called in two places to pick a tone for an auto-generated greeting, but was never written. A character with an explicit greeting, or one of the built-in cast, never hit that path, which is why this only showed up on freshly created characters. Added the missing function and confirmed, end to end in a real browser: create a character, open its profile, tap Edit — all work now.
